# x402-github-bounty

> Fund GitHub issues with x402: signed bounty certificates, merged-PR verification reports, settlement receipts. Non-custodial; pay in USDC on Base or Solana.

x402-github-bounty is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
